Setting the Cyber & Zero-Trust scene in Life & Annuities: Life books run on decades-long promises: underwriting quality at issue, servicing responsiveness across 30-year relationships, and actuarial integrity across regime changes (IFRS 17/LDTI). The machinery deciding those outcomes is data and document heavy — ideal ground for governed automation.

Underwriting evidence assembly is the concrete face of a general problem: the work is shaped for a world of manual checks and batch updates, while volume and scrutiny both grew. We start with the queue, the wait and the number they produce — not with a platform license.
What the operations floor feels every week
For Life & Annuities, as operators describe it:

items: APS records, paramedical data and financial underwriting arrive as documents; assembly consumes days per case.
Valuation and experience studies assemble from extracts with manual reconciliation; regime changes (IFRS 17) expose the debt.
Surrender, loan and beneficiary transactions route through document-heavy queues with abandonment risk.
Underwriting health data and beneficiary PII create long-retention sensitive estates; PQ exposure deep.

blocks.x: In Life & Annuities, the pattern is long-retention data protection — classification-aware controls for health/PII archives.
